headline: Yelp already has Suite C. Orange Book still drops the suite.
summary: This is a real shop at 2435 Alpine Boulevard, Suite C. Becky and Kris/Chris already show up in the reviews. Yelp is claimed, 4.2 from about 28 notes, updated this month. The phone is (619) 722-1707. Orange Book this week still prints alpinemotorsportsandequipmentrepair@hotmail.com. There is no shop site. Yelp, Yahoo, and MapQuest print Monday through Saturday 8 to 6, Sunday closed, and keep Suite C. Orange Book keeps the boulevard and drops the suite. A leftover card still closes Monday and opens Sunday. A neighbor with a dead mower can miss the bay in the building, or trust an old Hotmail door that may not be read.

signals.note: You show up for small engines and dirt bikes in Alpine. Yelp is claimed, 4.2 from about 28 reviews, updated this month. People already ask for Becky and Kris/Chris by name. A neighbor looking for a mower, a generator, or a quad can find you.
signals.next: Keep the category small engine and motorcycle repair in Alpine. Lawn and farm iron should stay in the listing, not only the about blurb.

signals.note: The number (619) 722-1707 is consistent on Yelp, Yahoo, MapQuest, and Orange Book. Call is how people actually book. That door works. Orange Book this week still prints alpinemotorsportsandequipmentrepair@hotmail.com. There is no shop site to confirm it. An old Hotmail box is how a quote never arrives.
signals.next: Keep 722-1707 as the only public phone. If the Hotmail box is still read, say so. If it is not, take it off Orange Book.

signals.note: Yelp, Yahoo, MapQuest, and Orange Book all print Monday through Saturday 8 to 6, Sunday closed. That is cleaner than most shops. A leftover card still prints Monday closed and Sunday 8 to 6. There is no shop-owned card to prove the week. A Sunday card is how a neighbor drives to Alpine Boulevard to a bay that is locked.
signals.next: Write one hour card, including Sunday closed. Copy it to Google and Yelp the same morning. Fix the leftover Sunday open.

signals.note: The work is in the reviews. Neighbors talk about generators, GSXRs, and lawn mowers. Yelp has about 6 photos. Public listings do not clearly show this week's bay the way a first-time owner would need.
signals.next: Put four current photos on Google: the Suite C door, a mower in progress, a dirt bike, and Becky or the crew.

signals.note: There is no shop site. Neighbors find the bay on Yelp. That works until someone wants Suite C, the week, and an inbox without opening an app. No site is a missing front door, not a small rot.
signals.next: A simple one-pager is enough: phone, 2435 Alpine Boulevard Suite C, weekday and Saturday hours, and three photos of the work. Yelp can stay. It should not be the only door.

signals.note: Phone lines up: (619) 722-1707. Yelp, Yahoo, and MapQuest keep Suite C. Orange Book and some leftover cards drop the suite and pin the boulevard only. A missing suite is how a neighbor walks the wrong bay in the building.
signals.next: Put 2435 Alpine Boulevard, Suite C, on every leftover card. Street without the suite is not enough.
